profile.reading: This CloudHQ facility, LC11, is part of the LC Campus in Ashburn, Virginia. A prior research pass on this row flagged that cloudhq.net resolves to an unrelated Google Workspace and Gmail backup software company, not this data center operator, and could not identify the correct operator site. This is resolved this session, the correct operator site is cloudhq.com (not .net), which was fetched directly and returned real campus level technical data used below. Per CloudHQs own current page for the LC Campus (tier-1 operator source, https://cloudhq.com/campus/lc-campus/), this campus is in the heart of Ashburn, Virginia, directly off Loudoun County Parkway, and totals about 8.5 million square feet and 1,256 MW of total critical IT load across fourteen data centers, with 756 MW available critical load, as of this sessions retrieval. Because this is a fourteen-building campus total, it is not applied to any individual rows critical_it_mw. Data center industry directory datacenterHawk gives this buildings address as 22235 Loudoun County Parkway, Ashburn, VA, a single aggregator source, not independently corroborated this session. DataCenterMap separately gives 108 MW for this building, a single aggregator figure, not confirmed by the operator, so not applied to critical_it_mw.
